card.name: Start of long medical words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer medical word that is still unfinished, such as ant|iv|agal, ag|itated, orth|ostatic or phot|ophobia. It fires in drug-label side-effect and warning text.

modes.label: Anti- words
modes.description: The piece 'iv' inside antivagal or antiviral right after 'ant'.

modes.description: The opening piece of orthostatic, photophobia or pre-existing.

card.writes: It promotes prefixes like Post and post and suppresses other word starts, so it has little clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up when a long medical word has just begun and its ending is still to come.
